name: ayat
description: Daily Ayat — gentle reminders with verses from the Holy Quran on your browsing journey.

scripts.predev: mkdir -p build/chrome-mv3-dev/assets/fonts/Amiri_Quran build/chrome-mv3-dev/assets/fonts/UthmanicHafs && cp assets/fonts/Amiri_Quran/AmiriQuran-Regular.ttf build/chrome-mv3-dev/assets/fonts/Amiri_Quran/ && cp 'assets/fonts/UthmanicHafs/KFGQPC Uthmanic Script HAFS.otf' build/chrome-mv3-dev/assets/fonts/UthmanicHafs/
scripts.postbuild: mkdir -p build/chrome-mv3-prod/assets/fonts/Amiri_Quran build/chrome-mv3-prod/assets/fonts/UthmanicHafs && cp assets/fonts/Amiri_Quran/AmiriQuran-Regular.ttf build/chrome-mv3-prod/assets/fonts/Amiri_Quran/ && cp 'assets/fonts/UthmanicHafs/KFGQPC Uthmanic Script HAFS.otf' build/chrome-mv3-prod/assets/fonts/UthmanicHafs/
